python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/tool.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''function helper(''','''interface Entry {
  parent: string;
  stamp: string;
  items: Map<string, string>;
}

function loadEntry(key: string | undefined): Entry | undefined {
  if (key === undefined || key === "" || key.includes("/") || key.startsWith(".")) return undefined;
  const file = `${STORE}/${key}`;
  if (!isFile(file)) return undefined;
  const fields = new Map<string, string>();
  const items = new Map<string, string>();
  let inItems = false;
  for (const line of readFileSync(file, "utf8").split("\\n")) {
    if (inItems) {
      const sep = line.lastIndexOf(" ");
      if (sep > 0) items.set(line.slice(0, sep), line.slice(sep + 1));
    } else if (line === "items:") {
      inItems = true;
    } else {
      const sep = line.indexOf(": ");
      if (sep >= 0) fields.set(line.slice(0, sep), line.slice(sep + 2));
    }
  }
  return { parent: fields.get("parent") ?? "", stamp: fields.get("stamp") ?? "", items };
}

function helper(''')
s=s.replace('''  const names = [...new Set(index)].filter(isFile).sort();
  const stamp = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  let content = `parent: ${parent}\\nstamp: ${stamp}\\nitems:\\n`;
''','''  // Snapshot = the parent's items with the staged ones layered on top.
  const names = new Map(loadEntry(head)?.items ?? []);
  let content = `parent: ${parent}\\nstamp: ${stamp}\\nitems:\\n`;
''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -c loadEntry src/tool.ts; grep -n "loadEntry" src/tool.ts
